description: Operon-level test of genistein induction with a sliding-window genomic null, GSE8571
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, requests
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def load(gse):
    n=gse.replace("GSE",""); pre="GSE"+n[:-3]+"nnn" if len(n)>3 else "GSE"+"nnn"
    url=f"https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/{pre}/{gse}/matrix/{gse}_series_matrix.txt.gz"
    b=requests.get(url,timeout=240).content; open(f"/tmp/{gse}.gz","wb").write(b)
    hdr=[l for l in b.decode('utf8','ignore').split("\n")[:200] if l.startswith("!Sample_title") or l.startswith("!Sample_geo_accession")]
    d=pd.read_csv(f"/tmp/{gse}.gz", sep="\t", comment="!", compression="gzip").set_index("ID_REF")
    return d, hdr

df,hdr=load("GSE8571")
for h in hdr: print(h[:400])
ind=["GSM212687","GSM212688","GSM212689"]; ctl=["GSM212690","GSM212691","GSM212692"]
X=np.log2(df[ind+ctl].clip(lower=1.0)); X=X-X.median()+X.median().mean()
lfc=(X[ind].mean(1)-X[ctl].mean(1))

# restrict to real CDS probes (locus-tag probes, exclude intergenic IG_/IGRC_/AFFX)
cds=[i for i in lfc.index if i.endswith("_at") and (i[:3] in ("bll","blr","bsl","bsr"))]
L=lfc.loc[cds]
# order probes by locus number to build contiguous windows
import re
num=pd.Series({i:int(re.findall(r"\d+", i)[0]) for i in cds})
order=num.sort_values().index.tolist()
Lo=L.loc[order]
op=["bll6421","bll6422","bll6423","bll6424","bll6425","bll6426","bll6427","bll6428"]
opp=[g+"_at" for g in op]
obs=Lo.loc[opp].mean()
w=len(opp)
vals=Lo.values
wins=np.array([vals[i:i+w].mean() for i in range(len(vals)-w+1)])
p_emp=(np.sum(wins>=obs)+1)/(len(wins)+1)
U,p_mw=stats.mannwhitneyu(Lo.loc[opp], Lo.drop(opp), alternative="greater")
print(f"\nOperon bll6421-bll6428 mean log2FC = {obs:.3f}")
print(f"Genome-wide CDS mean log2FC = {Lo.mean():.3f}, sd = {Lo.std():.3f}; n CDS probes = {len(Lo)}")
print(f"Sliding 8-gene window null: n={len(wins)}, empirical P(window mean >= observed) = {p_emp:.4g} (rank {int(np.sum(wins>=obs))+1})")
print(f"Mann-Whitney one-sided (operon vs rest): U={U:.0f}, p={p_mw:.3g}")
print(f"Per-gene percentile in CDS lfc distribution:")
for g in opp+["blr6429_at","bll6430_at"]:
    print(f"  {g}: lfc={Lo[g]:+.2f}  percentile={100*stats.percentileofscore(Lo.values, Lo[g]):.1f}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
ax.hist(Lo.values, bins=120, color="#b9c6d6")
for g,c in [("bll6422_at","#c1442e"),("bll6427_at","#2e6fc1")]:
    ax.axvline(Lo[g], color=c, lw=1.8, label=f"{g[:-3]} ({Lo[g]:+.2f})")
ax.axvline(obs, color="black", ls="--", lw=1.5, label=f"operon mean ({obs:+.2f})")
ax.set_xlabel("log2 fold change, genistein vs uninduced"); ax.set_ylabel("CDS probes")
ax.set_title("GSE8571: genome-wide distribution"); ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.set_xlim(-3,7)
ax=axes[1]
genes=["bll6430","blr6429","bll6428","bll6427","bll6426","bll6425","bll6424","bll6423","bll6422","bll6421"]
v=[Lo[g+"_at"] for g in genes]
cols=["#9aa5b1" if g in ("bll6430","blr6429") else ("#c1442e" if g=="bll6422" else "#4a7fb5") for g in genes]
ax.barh(genes, v, color=cols)
nodv=np.mean([Lo[g] for g in ["blr2025_at","blr2026_at","blr2027_at","blr2028_at"]])
ax.axvline(nodv, color="#2f7d4f", ls=":", lw=1.6, label=f"nodABСS mean ({nodv:+.1f})")
ax.axvline(0, color="black", lw=0.8)
ax.set_xlabel("log2 fold change, genistein vs uninduced")
ax.set_title("fde-like cluster of B. diazoefficiens USDA110")
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
